scope: Test-only X-Trans demosaic research; production code, recipe, cache and bundle unchanged. No codec replacement or photographic fidelity claim.

candidates.decision: rejected: noise gradient/luma/missing-channel errors exceed unchanged limits
rejected: insufficient false-chroma improvement and edge regressions

verification.full_workspace_gui_xpc_reason: Only cfg(test) research code, protocols and research documentation changed; production decoder, broker and bundle unchanged.

limits: Synthetic holdouts use new parameters within the same analytic scene families; they are not photographic ground truth.
The two validation splits differ: do not rank DR2 and DR3 directly from their validation ratios. Shared development is available for comparison.
Reported percentages are ratios of RMSE to baseline, not perceptual color accuracy.
Worst individual scene/phase values are diagnostic; gate aggregation and thresholds remain those fixed in v1.
No timings, memory, camera calibration, codec provenance, Windows or E4 qualification in this campaign.
No candidate was tuned after seeing its validation results. Both are excluded from production.
Raw library tests include the declared CDDL codec; lack of LibRaw linkage is not a claim that the full implementation is clean-room.
next_experiment: Formulate a noise-aware green reconstruction with explicit confidence, freeze a new holdout before measurement, and keep DR1/DR2/DR3 failures. Do not promote a residual smoothing filter based only on achromatic averages.
